experiment: G2-L future visible-surface distance auxiliary supervision
surface_domain: same material patch visible in frame0, transported with the rigid simulated object; discrete pixel-surface path approximation, not complete mesh geodesic
input_features: identical G1 observed-only self, shared object, and eight image-neighbor features, width781
coordinate_calibration: reuse user-approved observed frame0 calibration, no new fit
aux_pair_rule: all unordered 48-query pairs, identical finite visible-surface pair mask for chord and surface losses
loss_normalization: point and auxiliary losses use training-only second moments; same chord-target moment for both auxiliary losses
selection: best trained epoch and auxiliary weight by validation scene-macro ADE; zero initialization kept as separate deployment reference, not used to hide trained outputs
primary_metric: scene-macro ADE, seeds averaged within scene before paired bootstrap
primary_intervals: 97.5% for two planned comparisons, 10000 paired scene resamples
interpretation: exploratory auxiliary-task test; distance branch shares encoder with trajectory branch, does not enforce output-trajectory surface consistency
